query:
SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.claim_number,
  c.document_processing_status,
  c.status,
  c.ai_assessment_triggered,
  c.ai_assessment_completed,
  c.updated_at,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_assessments a WHERE a.claim_id = c.id) as has_assessment
FROM claims c
WHERE 
  (c.claim_number LIKE 'DOC-%' OR c.claim_number LIKE 'KNG-%')
ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
